name: IconButton
usage: Secondary actions in toolbars and list items (refresh, more, download, close); accent style for Send

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon: a name, or an icon component such as Lucide's `Plus`.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label, used as the tooltip and the accessible name (required: an icon button must be understandable).

props.name: variant
props.description:
`accent`: solid accent color (such as Send); `ghost`: transparent background (default); `soft`: neutral
fill.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` inside list items, `md` in toolbars, `lg` for the primary action next to an input (such as Send).

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Whether to show the tooltip on hover; shown by default.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description:
Disabled reason: while `disabled`, hover or keyboard focus shows "label: reason", such as "You don't have
permission to download". With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`), screen
readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`, and clicks and `Enter` have no effect; the reason is
shown even with `tooltip={false}`.

types.name: IconName
types.summary:
Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`. Props that take an
icon also accept an icon component instead of a name (see IconComponent).

types.name: IconComponent
types.summary:
An icon component, such as Lucide's `Plus` (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`), accepted wherever an icon name
is: `<Button icon={Plus}>`, `<Icon icon={Plus} />`, menu items and so on. Names (`icon="plus"`) are convenient
and work in data such as menu configurations, but cover only the registered icons (`iconNames`); a component can
be any Lucide icon, or an SVG of your own. Both are drawn with the same size, stroke width and `tone`.

types.name: IconComponentProps
types.summary:
Props that Icon passes to an icon component. Lucide icons (`import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'`) accept them; a
component of another icon set, or an SVG of your own, works too if it accepts them, or passes them on to its
`<svg>`.

fields.name: strokeWidth
fields.description:
Stroke width in the units of a 24 × 24 view box, already scaled for `size`: the line is 1.75 px wide on screen
by default, whatever the size.

fields.name: color
fields.description:
Stroke color: `currentColor` (the text color) or a semantic color variable, such as
`var(--vl-color-danger)`.

fields.name: aria-hidden
fields.description: `true` for a decorative icon (hidden from screen readers).

fields.name: aria-label
fields.description: Accessible name of a meaningful icon.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: `label` is required: it is the tooltip and the accessible name.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Variants and sizes
examples.description:
`soft` suits places that need a visible boundary; `accent` is for main actions such as sending; `active` is the
pressed state of a toggle button.

examples.name: DisabledReason
examples.title: Disabled reason
examples.description:
When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: hover
or keyboard focus shows "label: reason".
